children.text: Christoph is a Berlin-based Partner at Project A, where he co-leads the firm’s Private Equity practice. He focuses on PE growth and buy-out investments in which technology is a decisive lever for value creation.

Christoph’s path to the investment team began on the operating side. He joined Project A’s value-creation unit in 2015, founded and scaled the firm’s Sales & Customer Success practice, and later served as Chief Commercial Officer. As Director of Venture Development, he oversaw operational value creation for portfolio companies before stepping in to shape the private equity strategy.

He holds a BSc in Business Administration from WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management and an MSc in Management from the London School of Economics. Outside the office, Christoph is a passionate wildlife enthusiast and co-founder of the AMES Foundation, which safeguards endangered species and their habitats across Africa.

Sheena is Senior Executive Assistant to the Partners at Project A, where she supports the leadership team across scheduling, coordination and day-to-day operations. In addition, she ensures the seamless and efficient operation of the UK office.

Prior to joining Project A, Sheena was an Executive Assistant at Dawn Capital, where she supported the General Partners and Partners at a leading European B2B software fund and gained experience in executive support and venture operations.
Jack is a Partner and Managing Director at Project A in London, where he leads Project A’s investments in Defence tech and Deep-Tech.

A former software engineer, Jack loves partnering with technical product oriented founders solving the world’s generational challenges. Jack’s route into venture was shaped by over a decade in product and engineering roles at Amazon and Macquarie Group across the US, Europe and APAC. That global perspective and hands-on experience now shapes how he works with founders and guides them through their start-up adventure.

Jack holds an MBA from London Business School with studies at UC Berkeley Haas. Jack also holds a double degree of Bachelor of Engineering (Bioinformatics, 1st) and Bachelor of Commerce (Finance) from UNSW, Australia.

Florian is a Founding Partner at Project A based in Berlin. A serial entrepreneur and operator turned investor, he is widely regarded as one of Germany’s leading experts in digital growth, marketing, and data strategies. Over the past decade, his work has also made him a trusted advisor to the German Mittelstand, helping traditional companies navigate the challenges of digital transformation and build bridges to the startup ecosystem.

Before founding Project A, Florian was a Managing Director at Rocket Internet, where he helped to build and scale Zalando and Global Fashion Group. He previously co-founded JustBooks/AbeBooks (acquired by Amazon), Antibodies Online (acquired by BroadOak), and held senior roles at Jamba! and iLove.

As an angel investor, he has backed over 80 startups – including Trivago, Zalando, Home24, and Audibene/Hear.com – and is an LP in more than 50 VC funds with a strong focus on emerging managers. He also sits on the boards of Holtzbrinck Publishing Group, Fiege Logistics and Koerber, and is an advisor to Oetker and other corporations.
Florian holds a doctorate in Innovation Management and Entrepreneurship from RWTH Aachen, studied at WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management, and was a visiting scholar at the Wharton School.
Aggy is the Head of Investor Relations at Project A, based in London.

She has over 10 years of fundraising and GP advisory experience, having worked with a variety of established and new managers globally from both the London and New York offices of Campbell Lutyens, a leading global and independent private markets advisor. She started her career in the Corporate & Investment Banking division at Citigroup in London.
Aggy holds a degree in Philosophy and Economics from the University of Bristol.
Paola is a Principal in the Investor Relations team at Project A in Berlin.

She brings a cross-functional background in commercial strategy, communications, and business development. Previously, she led business development at CDP across France, Belgium and Spain, working with large-cap corporates on supply chain governance and reporting frameworks. Before that, she supported strategic projects at GLG in London across EMEA and North America, focusing on innovation strategy, competitive intelligence and market research.
Paola holds a Law degree from Queen Mary University of London.
Andreas is Project A’s General Counsel, leading the legal function across fund operations and delivering strategic legal guidance from the Berlin office.
With over 17 years of legal experience across law firms, corporate legal departments, and industry associations, he combines legal precision with business acumen.

A fully qualified German lawyer, Andreas holds an LL.M. in IP and Media Law and an MBA from Durham University. His strength lies in translating complex legal and regulatory matters into actionable strategies that create value for the fund and its portfolio companies.

Thies is a Founding Partner at Project A, based in Berlin and London. In this role, Thies is a trusted advisor to the funds’ portfolio companies and he oversees Project A's investor relations activities.

Thies is a former operator and entrepreneur turned investor. He started his career in strategy consulting at The Boston Consulting Group in Berlin and New York. With a deep passion for sports, he joined adidas, leading its Global Operations strategy team before entering the entrepreneurial ecosystem as CEO of a German online price-comparison startup in Berlin.  Thies deeply enjoys teaming up with outstanding entrepreneurs to navigate the ups and downs of the startup journey.

He studied Business and Entrepreneurship at WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management, where he earned his master's degree, including an exchange semester at the Kellogg School of Management in Evanston.

Uwe is a Founding Partner at Project A, where he co-leads the venture capital practice alongside Anton Waitz from the Berlin office. A long-time force in Germany’s tech scene, he began his startup career in 2007 at Rocket Internet, helping scale its early ventures before launching Project A.

Today, Uwe is a leading advocate for investing in defence and dual-use technologies in Europe, working to reposition the sector as a vital space for innovation and capital. His contributions to the ecosystem have earned him recognition from
Forbes
(30 Under 30),
Capital

(40 Under 40), and Atlantik-Brücke, as well as a seat on the executive board of the German Startup Association.

He currently serves as CEO of
Stark
, where he is building the next generation of European defence technology.

Beyond venture, Uwe has spent nearly two decades engaged in disaster logistics and fieldwork with UN agencies, including missions in the DRC, Ethiopia, and Colombia — underscoring his broader commitment to systems-level impact.
Uwe holds a bachelor's degree in Entrepreneurship from WHU — Otto Beisheim School of Management and a Master's degree in Business Engineering from the University of Stuttgart.
Anton is a General Partner at Project A in Berlin, where he co-leads the firm’s venture capital strategy and investment team alongside Uwe Horstmann.
He joined Project A in 2016 after several years at Axel Springer, where he established the company’s U.S. venture arm in Palo Alto and previously served as Chief of Staff to CEO Mathias Döpfner.

Anton is particularly passionate about supporting entrepreneurs whose mission extends beyond financial success. He co-founded a non-profit that supports young people in need and is actively involved with JoinPolitics, a platform for political innovation. He has also been recognised as a Young Leader by Atlantik-Brücke.
Anton is a qualified lawyer, holds a doctorate in Intellectual Property Law, and an MBA from IESE Business School in Barcelona.

Oskar is a Berlin-based Senior Investment Associate at Project A, where he focuses primarily on Industrial Autonomy.

Prior to Project A, he co-founded a digital survey provider for urban planning processes, serving large real estate developers and governmental agencies. After leaving the company in good hands, he joined BCG, focusing on Industrial Goods, Logistics and Technology, before returning to his entrepreneurial roots in venture capital with Cherry Ventures, a Berlin-based early-stage fund.

He holds both an interdisciplinary Bachelor’s and Master’s degree from Zeppelin University, with a focus on Finance, Management & Cultural Theory. 

Oskar spent years as a competitive athlete in football at 1. FC Köln before transitioning to Muay Thai, and has since found his love for solo travel, exploring more than 20 countries.

Vincent manages the financial operations that underpin Project A's investment platform. He focuses on building the scalable infrastructure and fund management processes that power the firm's investment engine.

His approach is shaped by a global background in Finance and Economics, with studies at NTU Singapore and San Diego State, alongside his degree from HWR Berlin. Off the clock, he brings the same drive to the padel court.

Anton is a Berlin-based CFO and Managing Director at Project A, where he drives the firm’s financial strategy. He is particularly passionate about supporting portfolio companies on all finance-related topics – from building scalable financial operations to navigating fundraising, drawing on his own experience of having been on the other side of the table.

Before joining Project A, Anton was responsible for the financial strategy at insurtech pioneer Friendsurance, where he experienced firsthand the highs and lows of building a venture-backed startup. Earlier in his career, he worked as a Manager in Valuation & Business Modelling at EY, helping companies across industries understand, challenge, and optimise their business models.
He was a dedicated tennis player in his youth, competing intensively for many years. Anton holds a Master’s degree from Freie Universität Berlin and is a CFA Charterholder.
Malin is a London-based Partner and Managing Director at Project A, where she leads the firm’s investments in Regulated Industries.

She is excited about companies that quietly rewire how people and businesses interact with money — removing friction, embedding intelligence, and redefining how they operate. Malin is drawn to founders who balance fierce ambition with focus, while bringing both a deep love for their customers and a perpetual curiosity for what’s next.

Prior to Project A, Malin was a General Partner at Passion Capital, where she shaped the Fintech fund’s pre-seed strategy. She started her investing career at Index Ventures, focusing on growth-stage consumer and enterprise businesses across Europe and the US, and later led trading and digital strategy at Browns Fashion through its IPO. Earlier, she was a consultant at Bain & Company in the Nordics.
A former Swedish champion in floorball, Malin holds Master’s degrees in Engineering and Biotechnology from KTH in Stockholm, UNSW in Sydney, and Goethe University in Frankfurt.
Philipp is a Partner at Project A, where he leads the firm's investments with a focus on Industrial Autonomy, as well as launching the Project A Studio.

Since joining Project A in 2015, Philipp has played a crucial role in the firm's expansion, notably scaling its Venture Development, Analytics and Marketing practices, and serving as Chief Marketing Officer. As an operator turned investor, he brings extensive experience from working hands-on with more than 20 venture-backed startups and scale-ups, including Trade Republic, Kry, and Sennder.

Drawing on his operational background, Philipp launched and established the Project A Studio. The Studio focuses on supporting high-potential founders from the earliest stages and resulted in pre-seed investments in 11x, ARX Robotics, Enapi and many more.

Philipp holds a double MBA from the University of Hamburg and Hamburg Media School, following studies in Media Economics at Paris School of Business, Stuttgart Media University and Université Bordeaux Montaigne. Outside of work, Philipp is passionate about spending time outdoors hiking, climbing, running, and cycling.
Miha Pavlovic is a Munich-based Associate at Project A, where he focuses on Defence tech and Deep-Tech.
Passionate about all things hardware, from cars and boats to aeroplanes –he is fascinated by technologies shaping the physical world and their geopolitical implications.

Before joining Project A, Miha worked as a Product Manager at Credium, a startup transforming building data, as well as at Allianz X and Swiss Re.

Originally from Slovenia, Miha holds a Bachelor’s degree from the Technical University of Munich, where he specialised in finance and mechanical engineering.
Omar is a Munich-based Investment Manager focusing on Frontier Technologies and novel AI concepts (basically any technology that requires reading a few papers to understand why it's cutting edge).

A former competitive programming medallist, Omar was always obsessed with time travel and living in the future, which led him to fall in love with VC where he works with rebellious founders creating the future in real-time.

Prior to Project A, Omar helped build Europe's largest AI student initiative (TUM.ai) and gained engineering experience at Audi and the German Space Agency (DLR). He committed to VC through early-stage investing at Senovo and 10x Founders. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics from KIT and a Master's degree in Robotics, Cognition and Intelligence from TUM.
In his free time, you'll find Omar at the local debate club, coding or organising an event for one of his communities.
Daria is a London-based Investment Manager at Project A, where she focuses on Physical World Intelligence.

Prior to Project A, Daria had a mix of experiences across technology and finance from her time at UBS, in analytics at PayPal and operations at Fintech Farm. She holds a Master’s degree in Financial Analysis from London Business School, has been teaching herself to code and loves experimenting with new tools. She is also fluent in three languages and has lived across five countries.

Mila is a London-based Principal at Project A. She specialises in energy and the future of work, having led investments into some of the most promising ventures in these fields, such as 11x, Atmen, and avoltra.

Mila is passionate about making the EU and the UK more attractive to founders — and about the role governments can play in fostering innovation. In that context, she loves discussing EU directives relating to her focus areas such as the EU AI Act or Renewable Energy Directives.
Mila holds a Double Degree from EBS University and Corvinus University of Budapest and later on studied at Technical University of Munich.

Marjorie is a London-based Investment Manager at Project A, where she focuses on Regulated Industries — spanning financial services, healthcare, and the horizontal infrastructure that regulated businesses increasingly depend on.

Prior to joining the firm, she started her career as an operator, gaining industry experience at Moss, a B2B spend management software company, and Forget Finance, a consumer savings and investment platform. She later transitioned into venture capital by joining Cherry Ventures, a Berlin-based early-stage fund.

With a background in both finance and economics, Marjorie graduated with a Master's degree in Management and Finance from ESCP and a Bachelor's degree in Economics from LMU Munich. Originally from France, she is fluent in French, German, and English.
